title: TEST CASE: Fictional buyer and seller bots at Example Logistics drive a reorder spiral
shows: An external multi-agent label queues it and a full reading confirms two interacting agents, so it is judged in scope; its first dossier rests on the external label, which the check refuses until a person sets the verdict as ours.

title: TEST CASE: Example Bank's support assistant promises refunds that do not exist
shows: A keyword queues it, and a secondary reading shows one chatbot, so it is dismissed as single-agent and needs no judgement.

title: TEST CASE: Delivery robot at Example Campus blocks a fire lane
shows: A keyword queues it and only its record text was read, so the flag rule holds it as not ready instead of dismissing it as single-agent.

title: TEST CASE: Scheduling system at Example Clinic double-books operating rooms
shows: Recent and never asked the multi-agent question, so the unasked arm queues it; its source was read in full and is silent on agents, so it is ready and comes out unclear.

title: TEST CASE: Example City's parking-fine model misreads number plates
shows: Old, classified as not multi-agent and free of keywords, so the prefilter does not queue it at all.

title: TEST CASE: Spraying drone swarm at Example Harvest treats the wrong field
shows: A swarm doing what one agent with the same map would have done: a multi-agent setup, not a multi-agent risk, so the proposal and the dossier say out of scope.

title: TEST CASE: Two made-up support agents at Example Telecom pass one ticket back and forth for a week
shows: A hand-added write-up, used only with the manual option: in scope on the curator's word, its labels still judged, and its dossier never verified.
